S_AcademyLectureHall.text: Rex Fleet Academy lattice-physics lecture hall in a mature Core Worlds Academy complex: steep semicircular seating, low central demonstration floor, restrained blue-white Fleet architecture with gold accents, large transparent volumetric plotting space rather than a flat classroom screen. Lived-in student space, not a ceremonial hall. No incidental readable signage.

S_AcademyTrainingBay.text: Academy training bay: compact instructional cutters on maintenance cradles, technicians, carts, safety rails, blue-white Fleet surfaces with practical wear. Vector Three is a small blunt-nosed training cutter built for visibility and instrumentation, not combat.

S_VectorThreeBridge.text: Bridge of Academy training cutter Vector Three: six close stations around a wide forward viewport, exposed training diagnostics, mechanical access panels, blue-white structure with warm gold status accents. Instruments are dense but readable as shapes and color states; no invented incidental text.

S_PublicCorridor.text: Verified public corridor near the Core: a broad low-tension volume centered on a chain of BHA beacons. Green beacons mean the local volume has been verified safe; the safe cross-section is much wider than the beacon line itself. Ships travel near the line while continuously reading the surrounding field. Warp-black space outside, restrained luminous geometry, no fantasy tunnel walls.

S_CorridorEdge.text: Outer portion of the same public corridor where the low-tension gradient steepens. The route is still open behind Vector Three, but the next beacon is red because its verification state is unsafe or unresolved. Subtle visual distortion should come from measurement overlays, star displacement, and ship/load response rather than magical energy ribbons.
